# Rosemary focaccia

Makes one tray.

## Ingredients

- 500 g bread flour
- 400 ml warm water
- 7 g instant yeast
- 10 g salt
- 60 ml olive oil
- 2 sprigs rosemary

## Method

Mix, rest overnight in the fridge, stretch into an oiled tray, dimple, bake at 230 °C for 22 minutes.
